rows.grounds: locative singular of netra; in the eye
locative singular of tanmadhya; in that middle

items.question: What width and central mark define the eye in this bodily meditation?
items.inference: The eye's prescribed width centers on a black orb.
uncertainties: netre may be read as locative singular rather than plural
gender of vyāsaṃ depends on compound parsing
items.plain_english: In the eye there is a width of five yavas, and in its middle is the black orb.
